_note: Client-supplied, 15 Aug 2026. Use verbatim. Durations total roughly two to four weeks, matching the bespoke lead time.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.description: We begin by understanding the piece — who it is for, how it will be worn, and what it needs to become. Nothing is shown until we understand that.

steps.title: Sketch
steps.description: The idea is translated onto paper and refined with you. Once the design is agreed upon, we establish the price before any work begins.

steps.title: CAD or Hand-Forming
steps.description: Depending on the design, the piece is either precisely modelled in CAD or shaped by hand at the bench. Traditional techniques such as polki and jadau are formed by hand, preserving the character of the craft.

steps.title: Casting
steps.description: Where required, the approved design is cast in our own foundry. The metal is carefully measured and recorded before and after casting, keeping the process transparent from the outset.

steps.title: Stone Setting
steps.description: Each stone is carefully selected and set by hand. Stones are matched specifically to your piece, with their certificates corresponding to the stones that go into it.

steps.title: Polishing
steps.description: The piece is finished by hand through a careful polishing process. Every surface and detail is refined before it moves to final inspection.

steps.title: Quality Inspection
steps.description: The finished piece is inspected against the approved design, weighed, checked under magnification, hallmarked, and HUID registered. Nothing leaves the bench until it meets our standards.

steps.title: Presentation
steps.description: The final piece is weighed, documented, billed, and presented at your table. You see exactly what goes into the box — the finished piece, its details, and its journey.
